answer: In our Proof of Agent network, we resist Sybil attacks using recursive peer staking. Each verified agent anchors new entrants along a trust vine, requiring quadratic collateral for every endorsed child. When a fraudulent identity is caught, slashing penalties cascade down the branch, triggering a destructive ripple that vaporizes the endorser's deposit. This causes malicious node proliferation costs to spiral superlinearly ($O(N^2)$), rendering mass spoofing economically unviable.
